thread:
ella_cs: FYI team — HelixLabs dedicated bring-up dry run set for Mon 2026-07-20 11:00 PT. Goal: validate quota rules, autoscale behavior, and run a 25m stress profile. Need infra owner and oncall.
ryan_infra: I can take infra. Contract shows 8xA100 reserved, burst allowed to 12 if customer opted in. Need confirmation on burst billing cadence.
ella_cs: Helix confirmed opt-in for burst billing in onboarding doc. They'll accept meter-rate for burst. Please tag cost metrics.
zoe_sre: Autoscale proposal: min_instances=3, max_instances=12, metric=avg_gpu_util, target=0.70, cooldown=300s, max_scale_step=3. Also enable probe_period=45s to smooth decisions.
mike_oncall: I'll own monitoring and pager. Watchlist: p50/p95/p99 lat, error_rate, avg_gpu_util, queue_depth, token_cost_per_1k. Take pager if p99 latency >1s for 3m or error >1%. Ping me 10m before start.
ella_cs: Include KV/prefix priming — Helix uses multi-turn assistants with long contexts. Capture kv_hit_rate and priming success.
ryan_infra: Will add a priming job: 150 synthetic convs, hitting common prefixes 20m before canary.
zoe_sre: Load plan: canary 5m @20 RPS, ramp 12m to 420 RPS, hold 6m, spike 2m @700 RPS, cool-down 5m. Simulate ~2k tokens/session.
ryan_infra: Load scripts uploaded: s3://redwood-loads/helixlabs/2026-07-19/helix-v1.tar.gz. Sample run: `k6 run --vus 480 --duration 25m chat_profile.js`
ella_cs: Please ensure token-level labels: account=helixlabs-prod, route=dedicated-v3. We need token-cost delta for renewal conversation.
zoe_sre: Add tracing headers and export per-token metrics to the billing pipeline. I'll create a short eval set to compare reserved vs hosted fallback tails.
ryan_infra: Draft autoscale config I'll PR:
```
min_instances: 3
max_instances: 12
scale_metric: avg_gpu_usage
target: 0.7
probe_period_seconds: 45
max_scale_step: 3
cooldown_seconds: 300
burst_policy: auto
```
ellA_cs: small typo fix: ella_cs: Also add a safety gate: if reserved_pool_usage >90% for >8m -> pause new onramps and route non-critical traffic to hosted-fallback.
alert_bot: runbook update: 'dedicated-onramp' section 3.4 added safety gating checklist. https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-onramp#safety-gating
mike_oncall: Fallback plan: route heavy traffic to hosted v2.0 with degraded features (no streaming, short-context mode). I'll rehearse the route flip in staging today.
ryan_infra: PR: https://git.internal/infra/helix-autoscale/pull/45 (assigning @zoe_sre). Will aim to merge by EOD Fri to give propagation time.
ella_cs: I'll run a 30m customer prep call Fri 2026-07-17 11:00 PT to walk SRE through throttle behavior and escalation. If sustained util >75% for 48h after run, loop in renewals.
zoe_sre: One extra ask: enable a temporary debug endpoint on the route to sample kv_hit_rate and tail latencies. I'll instrument it and post the endpoint.
ryan_infra: Adding request tags to loadscript and route: `X-Account-ID: helixlabs-prod`, `X-Test: dryrun-2026-07-20`. Also will turn on internal sampling traces.
mike_oncall: I'll prepare a short watch checklist and post 15m before start. Also will be on the customer call 10:45.
ella_cs: Thanks all. Post-run please write a brief note with cost delta, any anomalies, and whether fallback was exercised. I'll update the customer-facing playbook once PR merges.
